templates.name: Search restaurants by reservation type, location, date, time, size and filters
templates.description: Search Tock listings for {reservation_type} in {location} on {date} at {time} for {party_size} guests, applying optional {cuisine} and other filters
steps: Select the reservation type (Dine in, Delivery, Pickup, Wineries, Events)
Open the location search and type and choose the location
Pick the date in the calendar
Select the time and party size
Optionally open the cuisine filter and check the cuisine
Optionally open additional filters and select options
Submit or update the search to view results

templates.name: Find event tickets by location, month and cuisine
templates.description: Find Tock events in {location} during {event_date} filtered by {cuisine}
steps: Open location search and choose the location
Open cuisine filter and check the cuisine

templates.name: Search a specific restaurant and check availability
templates.description: Search for the venue {restaurant}, choose date {date}, time {time} and party size {party_size}, and check availability
steps: Click Search and type the restaurant name
Select the matching venue from suggestions
Optionally choose a specific experience (e.g. Indoor Reservation)
Pick the date in the calendar
Select the time slot or desired time
Run the search within the venue
